figurative_meaning_en: The state or existence after death
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরকালের কথা ভেবে সে দুঃখী হয়ে পড়ল।
example_sentences_in_english: He became sad thinking about the afterlife.
Descriptions of the afterlife are found in religious texts.
note: This term is widely used in Bengali literature and religious discourse, drawing from both Hindu and Islamic traditions.
